candidate_ideas.statement: With the CE normalisation O_P(1)|_C=ω_C⊗γ^*O(2), one has W_4=ω_C^2 of degree 20, W_5=ω_C^2(−D) of degree 16, and L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{−1}=ω_C(−D) of degree 6 with χ(L)=1, h^1(L)=h^0(O_C(D)), and dim|L|=h^1(L).
For every degree-4 cover γ of a genus-6 curve C with D=γ^*(pt), h^0(O_C(D))∈{2,3}, and h^0(O_C(D))=3 if and only if C is hyperelliptic, in which case D∼2H and γ factors as β∘h with deg β=2.

If C is hyperelliptic of genus 6 and γ has degree 4, then the Tschirnhausen bundle is E≅O(1)⊕O(4)⊕O(4), and the conic-bundle comparison yields h^0(F(−6))≥2, so F is not isomorphic to O(4)⊕O(5): no balanced tetragonal genus-6 curve is hyperelliptic.
If (C,γ) is balanced (F≅O(4)⊕O(5)) then h^0(O_C(D))=2, h^0(L)=3 and h^1(L)=2 exactly, so |L|≅P^2 with no jumping of h^0(L) anywhere on the balanced locus.

For balanced (C,γ) and every effective degree-6 divisor Γ, the fibrewise CE evaluation φ_Γ of ranks 26→12 has coker(φ_4)=0 and coker(φ_Γ)≅coker(φ_5)=H^1(W_5(−Γ)), of dimension 1 if O_C(Γ)≅L and 0 otherwise; hence corank(φ_Γ)≤1 and rk(φ_Γ)∈{11,12}.

Over a reduced locally Noetherian base B carrying a balanced family, p_*L_B is locally free of rank 3 and R^1p_*L_B locally free of rank 2, both commuting with base change; a_L:B→Pic^6_{C_B/B} and P(p_*L_B) are canonical despite Pic(B)-twist ambiguity; and the relative Abel–Jacobi incidence AJ_B is canonically isomorphic to the Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle P(p_*L_B), smooth and proper of pure relative dimension 2 with dim AJ_B=dim B+2 on every component.

For balanced (C,γ) and Γ∈|L|, one has ω_C(−Γ)≅O_C(D) with h^0=2, the complete linear system is the base-point-free γ-pencil, γ is recovered from (C,Γ) uniquely up to PGL_2 on the target, the classifying map is injective on geometric isomorphism classes, and Aut(C,γ,Γ)→Aut(C,Γ) is a group isomorphism.

The excess of the actual relative fibre dimension of the corank-1 CE evaluation-failure incidence over the generic determinantal expectation for a 6×11 matrix equals h^1(L)=2 exactly (expected codimension 6, expected relative fibre dimension 0, actual dim|L|=2).
A point p∈C is a base point of |L| if and only if h^0(O_C(D+p))=3 (i.e. D+p is a g^2_5); this occurs on smooth plane quintics, so L is not base-point-free on the whole balanced locus.

Under explicit hypotheses that Γ is given by six disjoint sections (or reduced-support scoping) together with the degree vanishings deg W_4=20>10 and deg W_4(−Γ)=14>10, the relative Fitting identities Fit_0(coker φ)=I_12(φ)=I_6(φ_5) and I_11(φ)=O_B hold for the filtered CE evaluation over a balanced base.
Over the ordered pairwise-distinct locus, the Abel–Jacobi incidence AJ_B pulls back to the scheme-theoretic CE evaluation-failure locus of the filtered determinantal model.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 packet excerpt: deg W_fi|C = 2(2g−2+4·2)−4fi = 4g+12−4fi.
established_facts.statement: For the Casnati–Ekedahl summands W_{f_i}=O_{P(E^vee)}(2)⊗γ^*O(−f_i) restricted to C, deg(W_{f_i}|_C)=2(2g−2+4·2)−4f_i=4g+12−4f_i.
The CE obstruction degree for summand f_i is deg(ω_C⊗W_{f_i}^vee(Γ))=4f_i+n−2g−14, so vanishing is forced whenever this degree is negative.

established_facts.evidence: Packet canonical geometric bottleneck degree calculation: deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12−4f, hence deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{−1})=6 for g=6.
established_facts.statement: Under the packet CE convention W_5:=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(−5))|_C, for g=6 one has deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{−1})=6.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0001 [mechanically_verified; cases: all].
established_facts.statement: For d=3g−3+n, the open input is W_{−16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}), identified by Poincaré duality with W_{2d−16}H^{2d−16}(M_{g,n})(d).

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0036 [mechanically_verified; degree 26, map M_6,6 to M_6,5].
established_facts.statement: For the forgetful map M_{6,6}→M_{6,5}, the q=0 term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes because 26 exceeds vcd(M_{6,5})=25; with fibre cohomology only in q=0,1, no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.

On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover C→P^1 with balanced splitting F≅O(4)⊕O(5), the f=4 component of the CE evaluation obstruction has degree −4 for any degree-six divisor Γ, hence H^0(ω_C⊗W_4^vee(Γ))=0 and that component of the obstruction vanishes identically.

On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover C→P^1 with balanced splitting F≅O(4)⊕O(5), the f=5 obstruction component has degree 0 for any degree-six divisor Γ, so evaluation fails on Γ if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{−1}.
Substituting g=6 into the obstruction degree 4f+n−2g−14 yields n−10 for f=4 and n−6 for f=5; at n=6 the f=5 obstruction has degree exactly 0, making failure a single Abel–Jacobi condition O_C(Γ)≅L.

On any smooth genus-6 geometric fibre of the balanced tetragonal CE family, with M:=ω_C^2⊗W_5^vee of degree 4, one has h^0(L)=1+h^0(M) via χ(L)=1 and Serre duality h^1(L)=h^0(M), independently of the identification W_5≅ω_C^2(−D).

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0105 together with SRC-0004 degree receipt deg(O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C)=2g+6.
established_facts.statement: Granting the weak CE relative-canonical form O_P(1)|_C≅ω_C⊗γ^*O(2)⊗γ^*A and the SRC-0004 degree receipt deg(O_P(1)|_C)=2g+6=18, the residual twist γ^*A is forced to be trivial, yielding W_5≅ω_C^2(−D), equivalently L≅ω_C(−D) and M≅O_C(D).
In the filtered CE sequence 0→W_4→W→W_5→0 for (g,n)=(6,6), exactness of π_*W→π_*W_5 requires R^1π_*W_4=0, which holds because deg W_4=20>2g−2=10; likewise coker(φ_4)=0 requires deg W_4(−Γ)=14>10.

For a line bundle L of relative degree d on a smooth proper curve family C/B, the functor of relative effective divisors Γ with O(Γ)≅L is represented by the Abel–Jacobi fibre Sym^d(C/B)×_{Pic^d_{C/B}}B, closed because the relative Picard is separated; on a smooth curve Hilb^d=Sym^d. This model is correct over all of B, while Proj(π_*L) has correct fibres only where h^0(L) is constant.

The forgetful map from the relative ordered distinct configuration stack Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to the relative effective-divisor space of degree six is a finite étale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open locus.

χ(L)=1 for L of degree 6 on a smooth genus-6 curve proves only that the full Abel–Jacobi fibre in Sym^6 is nonempty; it does not prove nonemptiness of the reduced-support open or of the ordered Conf_6 incidence on every geometric fibre.
For the RED-0001 residual list the ordinary degree 2d−16 equals vcd for (6,6) (among other pairs) and never exceeds vcd, so vanishing-above-vcd alone proves none of the residual cases.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The reduced-support locus is only an open subset of the P^2-bundle AJ_B. Open subsets of fibres can be empty: without a proved reduced member of |L| on each relevant component, the image-dimension claim need not hold. Geometric-point injectivity does not force nonemptiness of that open.
invalid_steps.statement: From AJ_B≅P(p_*L_B) of pure relative dimension 2 and geometric-point injectivity of the classifying map, conclude unconditionally that the image in M_{6,6} of the reduced-support open of AJ_B has dimension dim B+2 and codimension 19−dim B.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The filtered snake/Fitting argument uses Γ realized by (or reduced to) six disjoint sections and the vanishings deg W_4>2g−2 and deg W_4(−Γ)>2g−2. Fibrewise corank ≤1 is strictly weaker than those scheme-theoretic Fitting equalities over arbitrary bases.
invalid_steps.statement: Assert Fit_0(coker φ)=I_12(φ)=I_6(φ_5) and I_11(φ)=O_B for an arbitrary base carrying a balanced family with any relative degree-6 divisor Γ.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: h^0(O_C(D))=3 characterises covers factoring through the hyperelliptic map (intermediate genus 0). Degree-4 covers through an intermediate curve of genus 1, 2, or 3 still have h^0(O_C(D))=2; constancy uses only exclusion of the hyperelliptic case.
invalid_steps.statement: Identify constancy of h^0(ω_C(−D))=3 on the balanced locus with exclusion of all non-primitive degree-4 pencils.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The excess identity only compares expected determinantal fibre dimension 0 with actual dim|L|=2; it does not control ideal depth, conormal sheaves, embedding dimension, or Hodge/Tate type.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer local complete intersection, smoothness, closedness, Gysin, purity, or Tate-type conclusions from the excess identity excess = h^1(L)=2 alone.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Prove or disprove existence of a reduced effective member of |L| on balanced fibres; equivalently, nonemptiness of the reduced-support open in AJ_B and of the ordered Conf_6 incidence on every geometric fibre of the balanced family.

Establish the relative Fitting identities Fit_0(coker φ)=I_12(φ)=I_6(φ_5) and I_11(φ)=O_B under explicitly stated hypotheses (disjoint sections or reduced-support scoping plus deg W_4=20>10 and deg W_4(−Γ)=14>10), or give a general base-change-safe formulation.

Determine the dimension of the balanced tetragonal base B (candidate value 15, via branch-count or equivalent with simple-branching and stabilizer analysis); only then is the numerical codimension 19−dim B in M_{6,6} fixed.

Perform an exhaustive component, stabilizer, and closure analysis of the full CE evaluation-failure locus, including unbalanced splitting types and special-curve loci (bielliptic, plane-quintic, trigonal-adjacent).

Establish stack-level full faithfulness of the classifying map of balanced tetragonal incidence data into M_{6,6} on all T-points, beyond geometric-point injectivity and the Aut(C,γ,Γ)≅Aut(C,Γ) comparison.
Determine local structure of the image of the incidence in M_{6,6}: smoothness, immersion, lci/regular sequence, conormal/depth, and any Gysin input needed for later localization.
Extend the relative P^2-bundle identification of AJ_B beyond reduced bases, via a cohomology-and-base-change argument valid for non-reduced locally Noetherian bases.
Decide whether a non-primitive degree-4 cover factoring through an intermediate curve of genus 1, 2, or 3 can carry balanced CE splitting F≅O(4)⊕O(5).
Identify the scheme-theoretic CE evaluation-failure locus with the Abel–Jacobi incidence over the ordered pairwise-distinct locus by an independent determinantal/Fitting comparison.

Prove Tate type (or exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand) for the exact codimension-13 contribution supported on the evaluation-failure locus, and assemble it into W_{−16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)≅W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21).
